# Color Picker

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:wa-color-picker` · Web Awesome · component · Forms · recommendation: avoid

## When to use

Ecosystem color picker; use the Kerf ColorField or ColorPicker.

- Only inside an application that has already adopted the optional Web Awesome integration.

**Not when:**

- Do not use it in Kerf UI; use ColorField (@kerfjs/ui/color-field) for a field that opens a picker, ColorPicker (@kerfjs/ui/color-picker) inline, or ColorSwatches for a fixed palette.

**Alternatives:**

- [ColorField](./color-field.md) (prefer-kerf) — Use ColorField for a color in a form or inspector.
- [ColorPicker](./color-picker.md) (prefer-kerf) — Use an inline ColorPicker when the color is the view's main task.
- [ColorSwatches](./color-swatches.md) (prefer-kerf) — Use ColorSwatches for a fixed palette.

## Imports

- Theme CSS: import `@kerfjs/ui/webawesome.css` once.
- Registration: import `@awesome.me/webawesome/dist/components/color-picker/color-picker.js` once (a side effect).
- Custom element: `<wa-color-picker>`.
- Declared side effects: custom-element-registration.

## Props

Typed JSX attributes: [`webawesome-jsx-signatures-v1.md`](../webawesome-jsx-signatures-v1.md) (import `@kerfjs/ui/webawesome` for types only). Use the Web Awesome attribute API; do not reach into its shadow DOM.

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Theme it only through `@kerfjs/ui/webawesome.css` and cataloged tokens. Do not restyle its shadow DOM or uncataloged `::part()` targets (`KUI-L011`).
